component.name: Wicked IDE
component.summary: Write code with AI models that run on your own machine

description.p: Wicked IDE is a code editor that downloads, runs and keeps up to date the open AI models your computer can handle, then uses them to help you write code. Nothing leaves your machine.

ul.li: A fast editor of its own: tabs and splits, find and replace, folding, minimap, word wrap, snippets
Two or three models recommended for your hardware, and the whole catalog and Hugging Face to browse
The right llama.cpp engine for your GPU, installed, verified and updated for you
